name: Syndesmodysplasic Dwarfism

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Clinical and Radiological Diagnostic Criteria for Syndesmodysplasic Dwarfism

criteria.description: Severe disproportionate short stature with markedly shortened limbs
Characteristic radiographic findings including metaphyseal dysplasia and abnormal epiphyseal ossification
Presence of joint laxity and hypermobility
Distinctive facial features including midface hypoplasia and frontal bossing
Identification of pathogenic variants in genes associated with syndesmodysplasia (if available)

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of severe disproportionate short stature with characteristic radiological abnormalities is required; supportive clinical features and genetic testing aid confirmation.
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is primarily clinical and radiological; genetic confirmation is not always available.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Disproportionate short stature with severely shortened limbs
searchTerms: short height with very short limbs
severe limb shortening with short stature

pathognomonic.symptomName: Metaphyseal dysplasia with abnormal epiphyseal ossification
searchTerms: irregular bone development at growth plates

occasional.symptomName: Mild respiratory difficulties due to thoracic cage abnormalities
searchTerms: mild breathing problems from chest bone issues
slight respiratory difficulty due to thorax shape
breathing trouble linked to rib cage abnormalities

rare.symptomName: Cardiac anomalies such as septal defects
searchTerms: heart defects like holes in septum

imaging: Radiographs showing metaphyseal dysplasia and abnormal epiphyseal ossification
Delayed bone age on skeletal survey
genetic: Pathogenic variants in genes related to syndesmodysplasia (e.g., COL2A1 mutations reported in some cases)
other: Clinical assessment revealing disproportionate short stature and joint hypermobility

distinguishingFeatures: Rhizomelic limb shortening rather than metaphyseal dysplasia
Milder short stature with less severe radiological changes
Later onset of disproportionate short stature
Predominantly metaphyseal abnormalities without severe limb shortening

redFlags: Severe respiratory compromise due to thoracic cage deformity
Failure to thrive with feeding difficulties
references: Spranger J, et al. Bone Dysplasias. Wiley-Blackwell; 2012.
Superti-Furga A, Unger S. Nosology and classification of genetic skeletal disorders: 2019 revision. Am J Med Genet A. 2019.
